GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 700m. Pushed along Two Wide @ 550m & pressured @ 450m. Chasing 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. No improvement in straight. # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated mount settled midfield & travelled only fairly in e&m stages. Rdr stated when tempo increased app 700m mount was under pressure to hold its position. Rdr stated mount failed to let down strongly from this point & was disappointing to line. Rdr stated mount appears to mix its form & noted it was a well-beaten favourite at its last start. P/R vet exam of mare, which was having its 5th start in the period fo a month, revealed no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last 12 Lengths from the lead, tacked on middle stages then drifted back agin, trailed 10 Lengths detached at the turn, held that margin to the line. [Stewards: App. jockey reported it was under pressure from 800m and was disappointing. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # last throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rider reported mare was under pressure from the 800m and was disappointing in its finishing effort. A post race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, taken across and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 750m and Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up , hit Lead 200m, quickly went clear and went to the line easing down late. (Blinkers AGAIN, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF FIRST TIME, Visors OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # bolted in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Went Straight back off the Wide gate settled down a long last 14 Lengths (1800m), margin 10 Lengths 800 still last however field now bunching, scrubbed along Straight made no headway # never close

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked Four Wide Straightening Up and kept coming in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON) # battled on fairly

Jumped ok Settled Down 11 Lengths off the lead fence (1500m), margin 8-9 Lengths 800, held up approaching Turn , Straightened Up nearer Inside still no room! Clear late ok to the line # couldn't get clear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race. Hampered near the 400m. Had difficulty obtaining clear running from 350m before being shifted out passing the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 8th 8 Lengths off leader/winner railed within 6 Lengths x Turn clear run home Just Kept Going One Pace - # Just Held Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious in mounting yard and contacted rail & vetted.

Jumped Ok Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths within 4 Lengths Turning for home rld home not clrst path until 100m Not Knocked About - # Inconclusive
